# Pooja Verma

> Computing science student at Thompson Rivers University in Kamloops, BC,
> working across full-stack development, applied AI and data. Open to
> internships and research collaborations.

## Who she is
- Bachelor of Computing Science, Thompson Rivers University, 2022 to present.
- Junior Research Intern (Mitacs BSI) at PataBid, Okotoks AB: owned a new PDF
  rendering engine for a construction estimating platform, integrated the
  Nutrient (PSPDFKit) SDK, and built the pipelines behind automated stamp and
  take-off detection.
- LLM model trainer at Outlier.AI: trained and evaluated 100+ models.
- Undergraduate research assistant at TRU: built a retrieval-augmented
  generation assistant used by 3,000+ students, improving answer relevance 40%.
- Programmer analyst co-op at BC Lottery Corporation: Salesforce (Apex, LWC)
  and Power Platform work for 4,000+ retailers; cut manual licensing work 30%.
- Undergraduate teaching assistant at TRU for web development and data structures.

## Research
- AI-Driven Post-Wildfire Ecosystem Recovery, TRU Student Sustainability
  Research Grant ($2,500), supervised by Dr. Ghazanfar Latif. LightGBM at 0.707
  weighted F1 over six merged environmental datasets; presented at the TRU
  Sustainability Conference.
- Automated diabetic retinopathy detection from fundus images using CNNs,
  UREAP Research Award ($6,000).
